Preserving every input row, filter predicate, transform, CAD artifact, V5 operation, threshold, payload and resource cap while materializing, filtering and releasing N009 before loading N010 will keep the exact physical source child at or below 4 GiB.

inheritance_and_delta_rule.conflict_precedence: The more restrictive clause governs. An EXP35 clause may change EXP34 only when it explicitly names the replaced EXP34 behavior and the exact replacement.

fresh_identity_and_authority_substitutio.rule: The following EXP35 identities and paths explicitly replace the corresponding EXP34 identity/path clauses. EXP34 artifacts remain hash-bound lineage or a source-free legacy oracle only and never confer EXP35 execution authority.

fresh_identity_and_authority_substitutio.replacement_completeness: Every EXP34 schema, lock/approval path, environment/test attestation path, output root, launch claim, source capability, child claim, journal, lifecycle measurement, orchestration result, manual-review path and global-result path is replaced by the exact EXP35 entry above. No EXP34 authority/output path may be accepted by an EXP35 verifier or command.

boundary_equivalence_fixture.base: Apply common_finite_row_formula independently to both exact-size members.

row 4: normal=[0x1.4e718d7d7625ap+664,0x1.4e718d7d7625ap+664,0x1.4e718d7d7625ap+664]; frozen-parent np.linalg.norm overflow must yield NONFINITE_NORMAL
row 6: replace the whole vector with normal=[0x1.19799812dea11p-40,0,0]; exact 1e-12 boundary rejects
row 7: replace the whole vector with normal=[0x1.19799812dea10p-40,0,0]; nextafter below rejects
row 8: replace the whole vector with normal=[0x1.19799812dea12p-40,0,0]; nextafter above retains
boundary_equivalence_fixture.reader_and_materializer: Both modes read the same generated PLYs into actual Open3D PointCloud objects through the same production reader arguments and call the production materializer. No fake-cloud-only result can satisfy the exact-scale evidence gate.

maximal_retention_memory_fixture.purpose: Isolate the maximum raw/retained lifetime delta. It is separate from the boundary-equivalence fixture and is source-free engineering evidence, never physical feasibility or quality evidence.

measurement_protocol.worker_and_arguments: The exact same hash-bound worker, Python invocation, environment, fixture manifest and downstream publication arguments are used; only the frozen mode token differs.
measurement_protocol.peak_rss_definition: max of 0.05-second sampled process-tree RSS and parsed /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size
measurement_protocol.measurement_boundary: Immediately before Popen through complete worker exit, including Open3D/NumPy/science-interface imports, both PLY reads, materialization, filtering, lifecycle proof and strict canonical JSON publication; fixture generation is excluded and occurs before all trials.
measurement_protocol.published_artifact_per_trial: SOURCE_FREE_MEMORY_QUALIFICATION_RESULT.json containing fixture-manifest SHA, mode, retained array dtype/shape/C-order/ownership/tobytes hashes, EXP31 report hashes, pair hash, lifecycle counters, operation counters and zero forbidden-access counters. Elapsed/RSS/PID values live only in the external measurement tree.
measurement_protocol.scientific_equivalence_projection: Compare only the canonical tuple of both retained point/normal/uint64-ID dtype, shape, C-order and tobytes hashes plus both exact EXP31 report objects and the exact pair_actionability object. Mode, raw-lifetime/lifecycle counters, claim/PID/path and external wall/RSS fields are retained for audit but excluded from this scientific projection because they intentionally differ.
measurement_protocol.failure_policy: After the exact unit suite and fixture manifest are frozen, any nonzero/timeout/applicable-mode-cap/publication/hash/equivalence/lifecycle trial failure terminally nonqualifies EXP35 before physical approval; no same-identity evidence rerun or fixture reduction is permitted. Ordinary pre-evidence unit-test implementation iteration is not a qualification attempt.
measurement_protocol.sequential_gate: All three SEQUENTIAL trials return zero, each wall <180 seconds, each peak RSS <=4294967296 bytes, exact output artifacts are byte-identical, max live source clouds=1, max live raw bundles=1, and every release proof passes.
measurement_protocol.legacy_source_free_safety_gate: LEGACY_BATCH is a qualification-only frozen oracle and is never a physical execution mode. Each of its three trials must return zero, finish in <180 seconds and stay <=8589934592 bytes peak process-tree RSS so all comparison artifacts can be published. This 8 GiB safety ceiling does not amend the 4 GiB sequential or physical cap and confers no production authority.
measurement_protocol.comparative_gate: median LEGACY_BATCH peak RSS minus median SEQUENTIAL peak RSS must be at least 33554432 bytes, which exceeds the 21741568-byte EXP34 overage with preregistered margin; the scientific_equivalence_projection must be byte-identical across all six trials.
measurement_protocol.interpretation: Passing is source-free implementation evidence only. It does not establish that the physical pair will fit the cap.

one_shot_execution_contract.prelock_approval_contract: An independent EXP35 prelock approval must bind the exact final preregistration, environment attestation, source-free test attestation, source-free audit packet, all inherited static inputs, all fresh code/tests, fixture generator/manifest/files and qualification measurements; it must set physical_source_execution_authorized=false and evaluator_input_authorized=false and authorize only immutable-lock materialization.
one_shot_execution_contract.immutable_lock_contract: The fresh lock must contain exact canonical path/size/SHA rows for every non-scan consumed static file and qualification artifact, path-only rows plus inherited expected hashes for N009/N010, exact fresh source/orchestrator/monitor/renderer command templates, the complete authorized-output topology, exact one-shot/resource budgets, the fresh environment fingerprint, and the exact prelock approval hash. It must reject missing/extra/drifted/symlink/alternate/parent-traversal paths and be created before any physical scan stat/hash/open.

authenticated source manifest, transforms, source CAD, mesh report, accepted mesh and CAD graph artifacts
fresh EXP35 execution contract, lock builder, process monitor, source runner, orchestrator, fixture generator and memory worker

one_shot_execution_contract.detached_postlock_approval_contract: After independent lock verification, a detached approval must bind exact EXP35 preregistration, lock, prelock approval, audit packet, test/environment attestations and all code/test/qualification hashes; require decision APPROVED_FOR_ONE_EXP35_ORCHESTRATOR_INVOCATION, physical_source_execution_authorized=true, evaluator_input_authorized=false, authorized_orchestrator_invocations=1, no retry/rescue and manual native review when a visual payload exists.
one_shot_execution_contract.permanent_claim_contract: Only after argparse, exact authority, environment and output-topology verification pass, create the exact global launch claim with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, mode 0600, full-write loop, file fsync and parent-directory fsync. Before each source child, atomically publish its exact capability and require the child to create and fsync its own O_EXCL claim before NumPy/Open3D/scientific import or scan access. Existing claim, capability replay, wrong mode/order/command/hash/PID or second child attempt is terminal.
one_shot_execution_contract.preclaim_rejection_semantics: Parser or authority rejection before the durable global O_EXCL claim is a rejected launcher invocation, opens no source bytes and does not consume the authorized ordinal. Once the claim exists, success, abstention, timeout, RSS limit or any failure consumes EXP35 permanently.
one_shot_execution_contract.output_topology_gate: Before the global claim, every exact authorized leaf and the global result/manual-review file must be absent or an explicitly permitted empty directory, all primary/replay source/measurement/renderer roots must be disjoint non-ancestor paths, and no symlink/special/hidden/alternate path is accepted.
one_shot_execution_contract.durable_accounting_precedence: Each scan hash/load attempt is atomically journaled before access. Terminal orchestration aggregation prefers the durable journal over missing child results after timeout, RSS kill, crash or persistence failure; a spawned timeout/RSS-killed child counts as a source child. A successful child is exactly 2 hashes/2 loads/4 byte opens, and successful primary+replay totals are exactly 4/4/8.
one_shot_execution_contract.static_toctou_rule: Immediately before every child or renderer spawn, reverify the original immutable lock SHA, detached approval SHA, executable invocation/realpath, capability/claim bytes and every non-scan static path/hash. Physical scan bytes remain unexamined until the child journal checkpoint.
one_shot_execution_contract.manual_review_and_global_publication: Renderer/native artifacts and manual review are required only when a scientific visual payload exists. The global result is published once after terminal orchestration accounting and may not override a numeric, protocol, resource or tree-identity failure.

honest_identity_and_output_contract.no_scientific_or_output_change_interpret: The exact EXP31 reports/pair, nested EXP30 semantic and visual objects, and EXP32 metrics/counters must be byte-identical to the exact legacy batch oracle on identical source-free inputs. Only the explicitly enumerated EXP35 outer authority, source-envelope, lifecycle, journal, orchestration and terminal-accounting identities may differ.
